rate_rule: m = m_k3p + (1-m_k3p)*fight_ema for network and prior; fight_ema starts at 0
mix_rule: K3P handover of the applied critic LR; fight raises LR and therefore s, which releases the anchor
horizon_note: K3P LR schedule and noise still read the declared horizon; fight_ema does not. Intermediate ablation.
decomposition: g_tot = g_adv + coeff * g_pen; g_pen = d(penalty)/d(critic) via autograd.grad, not written into .grad; one Adam step per role
